title: protect.js check log order is derived from STATE key order
answers: why are failing checks listed first in the protection workflow log
how is the order of checks printed by protect.js decided
change the display priority of check statuses in the protect workflow
body:
Invariant: the checks printed by protect.js are sorted by STATUS_ORDER = Object.values(STATE), so the log lists failure, pending, success, skipped in that order.
Enforced by: .github/workflows/protect.js:module.exports, the checks.sort call with STATUS_ORDER.indexOf(status), placed just before the longest-name and forEach logging loop.
Keep in sync: every status string pushed into checks must be one of the STATE values. A status missing from STATE gets indexOf -1 and sorts to the top silently.
Reordering the keys of STATE changes display priority, so change key order only on purpose.
applies: Applies to .github/workflows/protect.js check collection and logging; does not cover other workflow scripts.
says: Why are failed checks listed before pending and passed checks in the protection log?
